nodes.label: KERNEL — dev-tool SaaS template
nodes.rationale: Grafisch-tier software template (near-black x electric cyan, Sora + JetBrains Mono). Archetype I: the hero itself is a bento mosaic (lead tile, live console tile, stat tiles, CTA tile) over a grid-line background; features are a second bento with one featured big cell; three-step onboarding with code tiles and a three-plan pricing grid.

nodes.label: Typed live-console bento tile (character-by-character log animation)
nodes.rationale: Signature feature: a fake terminal tile types colored log lines (INFO/WARN/ERROR spans) character by character with setTimeout pacing and a blinking block cursor, simulating 'kernel tail --service api'. Under prefers-reduced-motion the full text renders instantly and the cursor is hidden. Marked aria-hidden since it is decorative.
